args.title: Fix README: npm run serve does not exist
args.body: File: README.md. The "Running locally" section tells users to run `npm run serve` after `npm run build`, but no such script exists in package.json, so the step fails with "Missing script: serve". Update step 5 to reference the correct script for starting the API (e.g. `npm start` or whatever script actually launches src/index.ts), or add the missing `serve` script to package.json and keep the README as is—whichever matches the intended workflow.
